I am verifying the classification information of fish in the image for a nature education activity. Please check only the top horizontal row of purple fish cards, identifying and retrieving their authoritative classification records one by one from left to right; stop when the Family of a fish is first `Percidae`. Do not move along food web arrows, and do not check objects outside this horizontal row. Please answer the following questions:
1. Which fish were verified in order? List the name in the image, scientific name, Family, and the judgment of "continue" or "stop" according to the card order. Which fish is the first member of the family Percidae appearing in this horizontal row?
